articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Andrew Chung)
articles.description: AI has sped up how teams design and build, but quality assurance (QA) testing hasn’t kept pace, and the web may be getting less accessible. articles.title: AI Sped Up The Build: How Can Accessibility Testing Keep Up?

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Victor Yocco)
articles.description: An AI feature can save users time on a task, only for them to spend it checking the results. This practical audit helps product teams decide where AI earns its place and what users need to verify its output.
articles.title: Should You Actually Add AI To That? A Four-Question Audit For Product Teams

articles.title: A New Community For In-House UX People

articles.author: hello@smashingmagazine.com (Eric Bailey)
articles.description: As LLM chat patterns become more widespread, making them accessible is essential to ensuring everyone can access the information, tools, and opportunities they offer. articles.title: Making Immersive LLM Chat Experiences More Accessible

articles.description: Replacing JavaScript with a modern CSS feature can simplify a piece of code while making the wider application harder to reason about.
